QuestInfo.name: The Great Blacksmith
QuestInfo.0: Now that you are Lv. 30, Kyrin says she has some interesting information for you.
QuestInfo.1: #bKyrin suggested that you find a skillful blacksmith to repair the broken Core Fragment.#k Ask Kyrin about the shortcut that leads to the Blacksmith Laboratory. \r\n#rTip: If you wish to go back to the Blacksmith Laboratory during the quest, you must forfeit the quest and start again.
QuestInfo.2: Can a mere blacksmith really repair the broken core?

npc.0: You're lucky the #bblacksmith#k made time for you, y'know. He's always so busy. You shouldn't keep him waiting, so I'll show you the shortcut to the #bBlacksmith Laboratory#k. Just let me know when you're ready.
